title: A complete Messages SSE stream with a thinking block and one tool_use block
notes: The body is the same shape the scenario mock generates: message_start, a thinking block, an optional tool_use block, message_delta with usage and message_stop. The caller must receive the head before the last chunk (a streaming assertion), every byte in order and no reordering. input_tokens 165 is 128 + 37 and output_tokens 120 is 96 + 24 for the tool-call reply; those are the mock's constants, not provider measurements.
